data_sources.risk_free_rate: 3.0% per annum (approximate Chinese government bond rate)

methodology.sortino_ratio: (E[R_p] - r_f) / sigma_down * sqrt(252); ref: Sortino & Price (1994)
methodology.max_drawdown: max[(peak - trough) / peak]; ref: Magdon-Ismail & Atiya (2004)
methodology.alpha_beta: CAPM vs CSI300; ref: Sharpe (1964), Lintner (1965)
